mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, state, error_code AS errorCode, trace_id AS traceId, correlation_id AS correlationId, created_at AS createdAt, completed_at AS completedAt, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(input_payload -> 'scenario') = 'string' THEN input_payload ->> 'scenario' END AS scenario, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(input_payload -> 'questionId') = 'string' THEN input_payload ->> 'questionId' END AS questionId FROM public.run WHERE run_id = #{runId}::uuid
SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, trace_id AS traceId FROM public.agent_invocation WHERE run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND depth = 1 ORDER BY started_at LIMIT 1
SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, trace_id AS traceId, correlation_id AS correlationId FROM public.run WHERE run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid

SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, parent_agent_id AS parentAgentId, parent_agent_version AS parentAgentVersion FROM public.agent_invocation WHERE run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND depth = 1 ORDER BY started_at LIMIT 1

SELECT sum(input_tokens) AS inTokens, sum(output_tokens) AS outTokens, sum(cost_amount) AS cost, min(currency) AS currency, COALESCE( min(model_id) FILTER (WHERE model_id NOT LIKE 'tool:%'), min(model_id) ) AS modelId FROM public.usage_record WHERE run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid

SELECT op.tenant_id AS tenantId, op.tool_name AS toolName, op.request_digest AS requestDigest, count(*) AS callCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE att.state IN ('FAILED','UNKNOWN')) AS failedCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE att.error_class = 'INVALID_ARGUMENT') AS invalidArg, bool_or(att.error_class = 'TIMEOUT') AS hasTimeout, bool_or(att.error_class IN ('UPSTREAM_ERROR','HTTP_5XX','5XX')) AS hasUpstream, sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (att.completed_at - att.started_at)) * 1000) FILTER (WHERE att.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS totalMs, max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (att.completed_at - att.started_at)) * 1000) AS maxMs FROM public.tool_operation op JOIN public.tool_operation_attempt att ON att.operation_id = op.operation_id AND att.tenant_id = op.tenant_id WHERE op.run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND op.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid GROUP BY op.tenant_id, op.tool_name, op.request_digest ORDER BY op.tool_name

SELECT count(*) AS stepCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE step_type = 'THINK') AS thinkSteps, count(*) FILTER (WHERE step_type = 'TOOL') AS toolSteps, count(*) FILTER (WHERE step_type = 'ASK_USER') AS askSteps, coalesce(sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at)) * 1000) FILTER (WHERE step_type = 'THINK' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS thinkMs, coalesce(max(step_number), 0) AS maxStepNumber FROM public.run_step WHERE run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid
